L Heritage ~An Oasis in Hanoi~
Sep 2026 • Couples
Breakfast was delicious! Since you can choose a single dish like pho or an egg omelet, the portion size is wonderful and gives you energy for wandering Hanoi afterward. Also, because it is in the center of the old town, access to Hoan Kiem Lake, Train Street, and Tan Long Citadel is excellent!! Even if you decline the room make-up, you still get water for the number of people, so let's ditch the hesitant Japanese people and get the water.
